description:
One GPS Historical Data series by year: every value with the source's own label, the source
    (publisher, title, page, URL) and the exact quote it was checked against, plus the series'
    definition BREAKS (never read one trend across a break). Get slugs from list_historical_series,
    e.g. deaths-bjs-state-prisons, homicides-gdc-via-doj, los-pct-released-on-parole-gdc,
    population-yearend-gdc-series, deaths-gps-registry (live). CSV: add ?format=csv to the REST URL.
name: get_historical_series
title: Get historical series
